messages.author: 4d992ac005b751e4
messages.subject: parallelize
parts:
Hello,
I was wondering if it is possible to parallelize chains in Nimble.
I saw a post on the subject of parallelization in the group, whose answer is that it is considered for the future. But it dates from 2015 so I was wondering if it had been done since. If yes, how can we do?
I thank you in advance
Ugoline

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/nimble-users/parallelize%7Csort:relevance/nimble-users/-0bCKjMzP0Q/TBEXAj3qDgAJ

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: parallelize
parts:
Hi Ugoline,

Unfortunately, not yet.

To parallelize from R itself, you could built separate model + MCMC objects and use one of R’s parallelization tools or even run separate R sessions, but you can’t use the same model + MCMC objects via mclapply for example.

Perry
